about: Phrasings of regulation questions, grouped by the passages that answer them. Two questions may share a cached search result only if their relevant passages overlap. Groups 'liability-*' and 'str-*' are deliberate near misses: the same words, different passages. Relevant ids follow retrieval-eval.json; the agent-style phrasings are modelled on queries the investigator actually wrote.
